derivation: from H5869 (עַיִן) and a derivative of H2729 (חָרַד); fountain of trembling;

occurrences.text: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
